AmbDescription:
Join us for a canicross meetup at Cochran Shoals Trail - River Loop, Georgia on Monday, Sep 7, 2026

We’ll start running at 7:45 am; I’ll arrive by 7:30 am. Note the parking location on the INTERSTATE SIDE this time. Parking at this trailhead often fills up early. There’s also an additional parking lot 1.6 miles away (the turnaround point). Restrooms are available at the trailhead.

Parking: https://maps.app.goo.gl/VNfoAHXELKkGRXX69
(I’ll be starting from the Interstate side.)
Route: https://www.strava.com/routes/3531109113627012330

Route details
We’ll run an out-and-back on the Cochran Shoals River path; 1.6 miles each way (3.2 miles total). Feel free to turn around early for a shorter run or do multiple laps if you’d like more distance. For the first lap, we’ll stick to the wide main path.

New to canicross?
Curious about canicross or thinking about getting started? You’re very welcome to join us! A full canicross setup is not required to attend or learn. All speeds and distances are welcome. 

Safety & guidelines
For dog safety, flexi-leashes, head halters, and “no-pull” harnesses are not permitted, and participating dogs must be 12 months or older. A non-restrictive Y-front harness is preferred along with a bungee leash if available

NACC follows a strict “no-greet” policy. Please keep dogs from approaching other dogs or people and allow space when passing. Dogs must remain on leash at all times (no exceptions).

Please clean up after yourself and your dog.
Note Chattahoochee River National Recreation Area is a fee parking area

If you haven’t already, please sign the waiver before attending:
https://nacanicross.fillout.com/t/dQrpDEnWaEus

We’re excited to see both new and returning canicross teams!

AmbDescription:
Intro. to Canicross

Canicross is a great way to connect and bond with your canine companion.  Anyone and any dog can do it!  Join us and learn the basics such as verbal cues, proper gear and equipment, what you need to know to keep you and your dog safe while on the trails.  I will have lots of gear and harnesses available to try and size to properly fit your dog from Non-Stop dogwear.  I want you to be able to feel comfortable hooking up and chasing tail on the trails!  Once you get started, there is no looking back!

After we go over the basics, it’s time to play!  The Woods Fitness park is a fun location with a variety of obstacles along the trails.  We can do a loop through their trails and play on some obstacles along the way or practice on a more open, flatter area in the field across the street.  The waiver for the Woods is listed below and there is a $10 fee to play on their trails for the day.

Are you a seasoned canicrosser and want to join in the fun?  Meet us for a fun day helping newbies get their start and play on the trails.  All abilities are welcome and highly encouraged to join in!

I’ll pack water for the dogs, but there are also water options on site.  Pack snacks to sit and visit after if you’d like. 

The Woods digital waiver and you can do your $10 payment online
https://thewoodsfitnesspark.com/waiver

If you are NOT a titling member of North American Canicross, first, why not?  Second, there is a waiver to sign for NACC.  There is not a digital link but I can forward it over to you.  Also check out NACC at https://nacanicross.com/
